title: Pure Danger!
summary: Pure Danger! discard and swarm strategy centered on cryptid monsters that reveal themselves to force random discards from the hand. Whether the opponent discards the revealed Danger! or hits another card, the deck generates continuous draws, searches, and field swarms to feed high-Rank Xyz and Fusion boss Grapha, Dragon Overlord of Dark World.

summary.title: Starters
points: Danger! Nessie! searches any Danger! card from Deck to hand whenever it is discarded from the hand.
Danger!? Jackalope? Special Summons any Danger! monster from your Deck in Defense Position when discarded.
Danger!? Tsuchinoko? Special Summons itself directly to the field whenever it is discarded.
Danger! Chupacabra! targets and Special Summons a Danger! monster from your GY (except itself) when discarded.

summary.title: Opening: Danger! Nessie! + Danger!? Jackalope?
steps: Activate Danger! Nessie! in hand, revealing it to make the opponent discard 1 random card from your hand.
If Nessie is not discarded, Special Summon Nessie from hand and draw 1 card.
If Nessie is discarded, trigger its GY effect to search Danger!? Jackalope? (or Danger! Bigfoot!) from your Deck.
Activate Danger!? Jackalope? in hand, forcing another random discard.
Trigger Jackalope in the GY when discarded to Special Summon Danger!? Tsuchinoko? (or Chupacabra) from your Deck.
With multiple Danger! bodies on the field, advance into Rank 4/7/8 Xyz plays or Link Summons.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Grapha, Dragon Overlord of Dark World is an allowed Fusion boss whose Quick Effect changes an opponent monster's activated effect or Normal Spell/Trap into 'Your opponent discards 1 card', continuously triggering your Danger! discard effects on their turn.
Danger! Bigfoot! targets and destroys 1 face-up card the opponent controls when discarded.
Danger! Thunderbird! targets and destroys 1 Set card the opponent controls when discarded.
Danger! Ogopogo! sends any Danger! card from your Deck to the GY when discarded, setting up immediate GY triggers or revival targets.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Danger! Disturbance! Disorder! is a Field Spell that destroys any monster that battles your Danger! monster, and banishes three Danger! Spells/Traps from your GY to wipe all cards on the field.
Danger! Excitement! Mystery! discards a Level 5 or higher Danger! monster to search a Level 4 or lower Danger! monster from Deck to hand.
Realm of Danger! prevents Danger! monsters from being targeted by opponent attacks or card effects on the turn they are Special Summoned.
Danger! Zone draws 3 cards and discards 2 cards (including at least 1 Danger! card), triggering multiple discard effects simultaneously at Spell Speed 2.
You're in Danger! reveals three Danger! monsters with different names from your Deck for the opponent to randomly Special Summon one.

main: Searches a Danger! card when discarded.
Summons a Danger! from the Deck when discarded.
Destroys a face-up card when discarded.
Destroys a Set card when discarded.
Mills a Danger! card when discarded.
Both players draw and discard when discarded.
Newest Field Spell: destroys what beats your Danger!; wipes the field.
Discards a big Danger! to search a small one.
Field Spell: protects new Danger! monsters; one attacks directly.
Bounces your Danger! and their monster; draws from the GY.
Summons a random Danger! from the Deck.
